question: In the context of Gupta dynasty's urban administration, which of the following statements about the **Adhishthanadhikarana **is correct?

options.text: It was a military council composed entirely of royal generals.
It was a court of law dealing exclusively with religious matters.
It was a Board of Advisors representing guilds, artisans, and scribes.
It was a temple committee managing offerings and rituals.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It was a Board of Advisors representing guilds, artisans, and scribes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The **Adhishthanadhikarana** was a key administrative body during the **Gupta dynasty**, focusing on urban governance and decision-making processes.

• It served as a **Board of Advisors**, representing various sectors of urban society such as **guilds, artisans, and scribes**, ensuring the inclusion of different economic and professional groups in local administration.

• The members of this body played a crucial role in managing and regulating urban activities like **trade, taxation, and public works**, thereby contributing to the efficient functioning of cities during the Gupta period.

• This council was instrumental in addressing the needs of the urban population, ensuring that the voices of skilled workers and traders were heard in the administration.
